🔐 Google Login Fix (Adult Section)

Google Login kaam nahi kar raha? Yeh karo:
1️⃣ console.firebase.google.com pe jao
2️⃣ cinenova-8987c project open karo

5️⃣ Add Domain → cinenova.site add karo
6️⃣ Save — Google Login will work immediately ✅

🎯 Playmate Match
Playmate account pe jitni bhi videos already uploaded hain unhe fetch karke, panel ki movies list se title se match karta hai. Match sahi ho to select karke playmateId us movie ke Firebase record mein seedha save ho jati hai — dobara upload nahi karni padegi.
🖼️ Poster Fix (TMDB)
Ek category select karo, us category ki saari movies ka poster TMDB se dobara fetch karke update ho jayega (jahan TMDB match mile). Source website (filmslb/hdfun waghera) ka poster overwrite ho jayega.
